title: Stochastic Segmentation Networks: Modelling Spatially Correlated Aleatoric Uncertainty
mechanism: Models logits as a low-rank multivariate Gaussian, giving spatially coherent mask samples at little extra cost.
adaptation: Replace the crack logit head with a low-rank Gaussian head. Average the samples, or pick the sample with the highest expected IoU, and use the variance as a calibrated crack uncertainty for review flags and severity.
min_experiment: Arm = house PF + SSN crack head (5 seeds) versus house PF. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2, ECE. Kill if IoU < +0.012 and ECE does not improve.
evidence: R: LIDC lung nodule and BraTS; better sample diversity and quality than Probabilistic U-Net (abstract).

alt_notes.adaptation: Low-rank Gaussian crack head on the house decoder (base of the style-conditioned SSN); mainly calibrated crack uncertainty for severity and human-review flags.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: SSN crack head, 5 seeds vs house PF; metrics clean-49 crack IoU (mean prediction) and crack ECE; kill if IoU drops > 0.01 or ECE not better by 20%.
